business_problem: Crédit Agricole needed a more reliable way to consolidate and analyze IT spending and resource allocation across a very large banking group because prior KPI tooling was too coarse for daily governance and budget control.
solution_summary: Crédit Agricole S.A. used IBM Planning Analytics on Cloud and IBM Cognos Analytics on Cloud to build VERDI, a group-wide platform for collecting, analyzing, and presenting IT spending information. The solution tracks six categories of IT indicators—including expenses, workforce, projects, purchases, fixed assets, and infrastructure-service consumption—across 43 group entities, then exposes those views through two interfaces: VERDI for management controllers and TEMPO for executive decision-makers. IBM provided the core SaaS analytics stack and ongoing support, while the bank’s teams and a systems integrator iteratively expanded the indicator set after the initial 2022 deployment. The platform now gives CIOs, finance leaders, and governance teams a consolidated, detailed, and more auditable view of resource use, allowing them to monitor a multibillion-euro technology estate more rigorously. Rather than relying on macro-level KPIs, Crédit Agricole can use the same analytical foundation for everyday management, strategic investment review, and increasing regulatory scrutiny around transformation spending.

solution_components.name: IBM Planning Analytics on Cloud
solution_components.role: Drives the collection, consolidation, and analysis of group-wide IT spending and resource data.

solution_components.name: IBM Cognos Analytics on Cloud
solution_components.role: Presents consolidated IT spending and resource indicators to leadership and governance stakeholders.

data_flow: IT expenditure and resource indicators from 43 group entities are consolidated in Planning Analytics on Cloud, structured into VERDI and TEMPO views, and surfaced through Cognos dashboards for management controllers, CIOs, and executive decision-makers.
business_outcome: Crédit Agricole gained a reliable, detailed, and auditable view of IT spending across the group, giving 200 users better tools for daily governance, resource allocation, and regulatory reporting.
metrics: €20 billion planned IT expenditure between 2022 and 2025
45 indicators dedicated to IT expenditure management
200 employees intended to use the tool
53 million customers served by the group
architecture_clues: The solution is split between VERDI for collection/analysis and TEMPO for data presentation.
The initial deployment went live in early 2022 after a year of development.
The platform is used not only for management but also for auditability and regulatory transformation indicators.
